components.name: accordion
components.description: Vertically stacked set of collapsible sections. Wrap `ui-accordion-item` children inside `ui-accordion`, each identified by its own `value`. Bind `[(expandedValues)]` to control which item(s) are open, or leave it uncontrolled (all closed by default). `multiple` allows more than one section open at once. Arrow Up/Down, Home and End move focus between section headers.

components.name: alert
components.description: Inline banner for contextual messages within page content, such as a warning above a form. Use `Notification` instead for temporary, toast-like messages. `type` sets the icon, color and ARIA role: `error` uses `role="alert"` to interrupt, the other types use `role="status"`. There is no `open` input; dismissing hides the alert internally and emits `dismissed` so the caller can react, e.g. to remove it from a list.

props.name: heading

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Shows a close button that hides the alert when clicked (see the `dismissed` output).

props.name: dismissed

components.name: alert-dialog
components.description: Confirmation dialog for actions that need an explicit confirm or cancel, such as deleting a record. Use it instead of `Modal` when the content is a `heading`, a `message` and two actions, rather than arbitrary projected content. Renders with `role="alertdialog"` and exposes `message` through `aria-describedby` so assistive technology reads it together with the heading. Clicking the backdrop does not dismiss the dialog by default; Escape and the Cancel button both emit `cancelled`.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: Label for the confirm button.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: Label for the cancel button.

props.name: variant

props.name: closeOnBackdrop
props.description: Whether clicking the backdrop cancels the dialog. Defaults to `false`, unlike `Modal`.

props.name: showCloseButton
props.description: Shows an `X` close button in the header; clicking it cancels, same as Escape.

props.name: loading
props.description: Disables the cancel button and shows a loading state on the confirm button while an async confirm is in flight.

props.description: Extra utility classes appended to the underlying `Modal` panel.

props.name: cancelled

components.name: autocomplete
components.description: Free-text input with a filterable, keyboard-navigable list of suggestions. Unlike `Combobox`, the typed text is always the committed `value`. Suggestions in `suggestions` are only an assist: submitting text that matches none of them is fully supported. Use Arrow Up/Down to move through the list, Enter to select the highlighted suggestion, and Escape to close it.

props.name: value

props.name: selected

components.name: avatar
components.description: User or entity avatar with automatic fallback between an image, initials and an icon. When `src` is set the image is shown first, and falls back to `initials` (then `icon`) automatically if it fails to load. `alt` is the accessible name in every case: it is used as the `` when an image renders, and as `aria-label` on the container otherwise.

props.name: alt

props.name: initials

props.name: variant

components.name: badge

The status variants (`success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info`) render with a light background and matching text color. When a badge conveys meaning without its own visible text, such as a bare status dot, pass `ariaLabel` to give it an accessible name.

Every item except the last renders as a `ui-link`; the last renders as plain text with `aria-current="page"`.

components.name: button
components.description: Button styling and behavior applied directly to a native ``, `Settings`. Because the host is the real element, everything native works as usual: `type`, `[style]`, `class`, `routerLink`, `(click)`, `aria-*`, forms. Put any content inside, including your own icons; `icon` is a shortcut for a Lucide icon next to the label. `variant` sets the style (`primary`, `secondary` outline, `tertiary` text-only, `icon` round icon-only), `color` the severity (`danger`, `success`, `warning`, `info`) or a neutral `surface`, and `shape="pill"` fully rounds a text button. Icon-only buttons need an accessible name: set `aria-label`, or add `uiTooltip` to the same element and its text is used. In development, an icon-only button with neither logs a warning.

props.name: color

props.name: shape
props.description: `'pill'` fully rounds a text button. Icon-only buttons are always round.

props.name: size
props.description: Controls height/padding/text size; `'icon'`-variant buttons ignore this and stay a fixed round size.

props.name: icon
props.description: Lucide icon shown next to the label (or alone, for `variant="icon"`). You can also project your own icon markup.

props.name: iconPos
props.description: Side `icon` renders on, relative to the projected content. Ignored for `variant="icon"`.

props.name: disabled

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinning loader in place of the content and disables the button while `true`.

props.name: inverse
props.description: Renders the button for use on a dark/colored background (white text/border instead of the tinted default).

components.name: calendar

Restrict which dates are selectable with `disabledDates`, `disabledWeekdays`, `enabledDates`, `canSelectPreviousDates`, `canSelectCurrentDay`, `minEnabledDate` and `maxEnabledDate`. Set `canDeselectDate` to allow clearing the selection by clicking the selected day again.

props.name: maxEnabledDate

Options can be plain values or objects. When using objects, set `optionLabel`, `optionValue` and `optionDisabledKey` to the property names to read from each option.

components.name: data-table
components.description: Sortable, paginated, selectable table driven by a column config. Customize rendering per column with `uiTemplate="cell-<key>"` and `uiTemplate="header-<key>"`, and the empty state with `uiTemplate="empty"`. By default the table runs in client-side mode: pass the full dataset via `data`, and sorting, filtering and paging all happen in memory. Set `totalCount` to switch to controlled mode: pass only the current page's rows in `data`, and the table reflects `page`, `sortState` and `globalFilter` changes instead of slicing or sorting internally, so you can refetch from the backend. Set `rowKey` to extract a stable identity per row, for example `(row) => row.id`, when rows are recreated across page fetches. It defaults to the row object itself.

props.name: columns

props.name: selected

props.name: sortState

props.name: loading

props.name: globalFilter

props.name: ariaLabel

Use `Sidebar` instead for a persistent, always-visible navigation layout.

components.name: dropdown-menu
components.description: Trigger button + floating panel, with named `button`/`menu` templates (via `uiTemplate`) for custom trigger content and menu items — falls back to plain text if omitted. Positioned with `FloatingPanel` (flip/shift, repositions on scroll), same as `Popover` and `Combobox` — the panel is rendered through a CDK overlay rather than as a DOM child of the trigger, so it's never clipped or forced into scroll by an overflow/scrolling ancestor. Menu semantics: trigger has `aria-haspopup="menu"` + `aria-expanded`, the panel has `role="menu"`, closes on outside click and Escape (returning focus to the trigger on Escape), and Up/Down/Home/End arrow keys move focus between elements marked `role="menuitem"` inside the panel content the caller provides.

components.name: file-upload

components.name: skeleton
components.description: Pulsing placeholder for content that hasn't loaded yet. Purely decorative — `aria-hidden`.

api.name: Skeleton
api.description: Pulsing placeholder for content that hasn't loaded yet. Purely decorative — `aria-hidden`.

props.name: width
props.description: CSS width of the placeholder block (any valid CSS length, e.g. `'40px'`, `'60%'`).

props.name: height
props.description: CSS height of the placeholder block.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Extra utility classes, e.g. `'rounded-full'` for an avatar-shaped placeholder.

components.name: slider
components.description: Single-thumb range slider built on the native `<input type="range">`, with full keyboard (arrow keys, Home/End, Page Up/Down) and touch support. Use `formatValue` to customize the visible value badge and `aria-valuetext` for values that aren't self-explanatory as a raw number, for example a currency or duration formatter.

api.name: Slider
api.description: Single-thumb range slider built on the native `<input type="range">`, with full keyboard (arrow keys, Home/End, Page Up/Down) and touch support. Use `formatValue` to customize the visible value badge and `aria-valuetext` for values that aren't self-explanatory as a raw number, for example a currency or duration formatter.

props.name: value
props.description: Current numeric value. Two-way bindable via `[(value)]`.

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum allowed value.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum allowed value.

props.name: step
props.description: Increment size for keyboard/drag interactions.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables dragging/keyboard input and dims the track.

props.name: label
props.description: Text label rendered above the track; ignored when a `uiTemplate="label"` is projected.

props.name: caption
props.description: Helper text rendered below the track; ignored when a `uiTemplate="caption"` is projected.

props.name: id
props.description: Overrides the auto-generated `id` used to associate the label and caption with the input.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Extra utility classes appended to the root element.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the range input, used only when no visible `label` is set (defaults to `'Slider'`).

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the current (formatted) value next to the label.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats the value for the visible badge and `aria-valuetext`.

components.name: spinner
components.description: Indeterminate loading spinner (animated arc), for standalone use rather than `uiButton`'s built-in `loading` state. The stroke uses `currentColor`, controlled via a text color class in `classNames`. Renders with `role="status"` and `ariaLabel` so screen readers announce the loading state.

api.name: Spinner
api.description: Indeterminate loading spinner (animated arc), for standalone use rather than `uiButton`'s built-in `loading` state. The stroke uses `currentColor`, controlled via a text color class in `classNames`. Renders with `role="status"` and `ariaLabel` so screen readers announce the loading state.

props.name: size
props.description: Width/height of the SVG in pixels.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Text color class controlling the stroke via `currentColor` — swap to reskin the spinner.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name announced by screen readers via `role="status"`.

components.name: stepper
components.description: Horizontal multi-step progress indicator: numbered circles connected by a fill line, with a checkmark on completed steps and the active step marked with `aria-current="step"`.

api.name: Stepper
api.description: Horizontal multi-step progress indicator: numbered circles connected by a fill line, with a checkmark on completed steps and the active step marked with `aria-current="step"`.

props.name: steps
props.description: Total number of steps. Ignored when `labels` is provided — its length wins instead.

props.name: labels
props.description: Optional label shown under each step's circle.

props.name: currentStep
props.description: Zero-based index of the active step.

components.name: table
components.description: Styled `<table>` wrapper with a horizontal-scroll container for narrow viewports. Compose it with plain `<thead>`/`<tbody>`/`<tr>` and the `uiTableRow`/`uiTableHeadCell`/`uiTableCell` directives below for a fully custom table, or use `DataTable` (`../data-table/data-table`) for a ready-made sortable/paginated/selectable table driven by a column config.

api.name: Table
api.description: Styled `<table>` wrapper with a horizontal-scroll container for narrow viewports. Compose it with plain `<thead>`/`<tbody>`/`<tr>` and the `uiTableRow`/`uiTableHeadCell`/`uiTableCell` directives below for a fully custom table, or use `DataTable` (`../data-table/data-table`) for a ready-made sortable/paginated/selectable table driven by a column config.

components.name: tabs
components.description: Tab set following the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern. Each projected `ui-tab-panel` child provides its own label, icon and disabled state, and renders its content only while active. Navigate between tabs with Left/Right (or Up/Down when `orientation="vertical"`), Home and End. Leave `active` unset to auto-select the first non-disabled tab, or bind `[(active)]` for a fully controlled tab set.

api.name: Tabs
api.description: Tab set following the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern. Each projected `ui-tab-panel` child provides its own label, icon and disabled state, and renders its content only while active. Navigate between tabs with Left/Right (or Up/Down when `orientation="vertical"`), Home and End. Leave `active` unset to auto-select the first non-disabled tab, or bind `[(active)]` for a fully controlled tab set.

props.name: active
props.description: Value of the currently selected tab. Two-way bindable via `[(active)]`; leave unset for auto-selection.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout direction of the tab strip and its keyboard navigation axis (Left/Right vs Up/Down).

props.name: classNames
props.description: Extra utility classes appended to the host element.

props.name: tabListClassNames
props.description: Extra utility classes appended to the `role="tablist"` strip element.

components.name: textarea
components.description: Multi-line text input with native forms interop (`ControlValueAccessor`, works with `formControlName`/`ngModel`) and a signal-based `[(value)]` two-way binding for standalone usage. Shows a live character counter under the field whenever `maxLength` is set and no `caption`/caption template is provided.

api.name: Textarea
api.description: Multi-line text input with native forms interop (`ControlValueAccessor`, works with `formControlName`/`ngModel`) and a signal-based `[(value)]` two-way binding for standalone usage. Shows a live character counter under the field whenever `maxLength` is set and no `caption`/caption template is provided.

props.name: value
props.description: Current text. Two-way bindable via `[(value)]`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field and marks it as disabled for `ControlValueAccessor` consumers.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text shown in the field when empty.

props.name: label
props.description: Static label text shown above the field; ignored when a `uiTemplate="label"` is projected.

props.name: caption
props.description: Static caption text shown below the field; ignored when a `uiTemplate="caption"` is projected.

props.name: id
props.description: Overrides the auto-generated id used to link the `<label for>` and `aria-describedby`.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Extra utility classes appended to the `<textarea>` element, for one-off overrides.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Enforces the native `maxlength` attribute and, when set, shows a "current / max" character counter.

components.name: timeline
components.description: Vertical timeline list. Wraps `ui-timeline-item` children in an `<ol>` with a connecting left border; each item draws its own segment of the vertical line and its marker.

api.name: Timeline
api.description: Vertical timeline list. Wraps `ui-timeline-item` children in an `<ol>` with a connecting left border; each item draws its own segment of the vertical line and its marker.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Extra utility classes appended to the host `<ol>` element.

components.name: toast
components.description: Mount once (e.g. in the app shell). Renders whatever `ToastService` queues, stacked per corner. Inject `ToastService` anywhere to push toasts: `toastService.success('Saved!')`.

api.name: Toaster
api.description: Mount once (e.g. in the app shell). Renders whatever `ToastService` queues, stacked per corner. Inject `ToastService` anywhere to push toasts: `toastService.success('Saved!')`.

components.name: toggle
components.description: Boolean on/off switch with native forms interop (`ControlValueAccessor`, works with `formControlName`/`ngModel`) and a signal-based `[(checked)]` two-way binding for standalone usage.

api.name: Toggle
api.description: Boolean on/off switch with native forms interop (`ControlValueAccessor`, works with `formControlName`/`ngModel`) and a signal-based `[(checked)]` two-way binding for standalone usage.

props.name: checked
props.description: On/off state. Two-way bindable via `[(checked)]`.

props.name: color
props.description: Track color shown while checked.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the track/thumb.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction and marks the control as disabled for `ControlValueAccessor` consumers.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible label for screen readers, since the control has no visible text.

components.name: tooltip
components.description: Floating tooltip panel used internally by the `uiTooltip` directive, which creates and positions instances of it on demand. Not meant to be used directly in a template; apply `uiTooltip` to an element instead.

api.name: Tooltip
api.description: Floating tooltip panel used internally by the `uiTooltip` directive, which creates and positions instances of it on demand. Not meant to be used directly in a template; apply `uiTooltip` to an element instead.

props.name: text
props.description: Plain-text body content; ignored when `template` is provided.

props.name: heading
props.description: Optional bold heading shown above the body content.

props.name: template
props.description: Custom body content, rendered instead of `text` when set.

props.name: position
props.description: Side of the anchor element the panel is placed on.

props.name: left
props.description: Absolute `left` pixel coordinate the panel is positioned at, set by `TooltipDirective`.

props.name: top
props.description: Absolute `top` pixel coordinate the panel is positioned at, set by `TooltipDirective`.

props.name: width
props.description: Max width of the panel in pixels.

props.name: visible
props.description: Shows or hides the panel.

props.name: tooltipId
props.description: Id applied to the panel element so a trigger can reference it via `aria-describedby`.

components.name: url-copy
components.description: Click-to-copy URL chip. Copies `url` to the clipboard when clicked, and shows `copiedLabel` in place of `label` for `duration` ms as feedback. Emits `copied` once the URL has been successfully written to the clipboard, so callers can react, for example to log analytics.

api.name: UrlCopy
api.description: Click-to-copy URL chip. Copies `url` to the clipboard when clicked, and shows `copiedLabel` in place of `label` for `duration` ms as feedback. Emits `copied` once the URL has been successfully written to the clipboard, so callers can react, for example to log analytics.

props.name: url
props.description: URL copied to the clipboard when the chip is clicked.

props.name: label
props.description: Label shown before copying.

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: Label shown in place of `label` for `duration` ms after a successful copy.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long, in ms, the "copied" feedback state is shown before reverting to `label`.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Extra utility classes appended to the host button.

props.name: copied
props.description: Emits once the URL has been successfully written to the clipboard.
